meta.name: smc_quant bucket feature registry
meta.row_model: one row per (bucket_id, direction); entry-legal fields identical across the long/short pair

scopes.name: BASE selection
scopes.definition: The 15 buckets BEFORE entry + the entry bucket (16 total), extracted at entry close.

scopes.name: JOURNEY selection
scopes.definition: Entry bucket through the bucket that TOUCHED the barrier (TP or SL).

scopes.name: EXCURSION selection
scopes.definition: Entry bucket through the bucket of the DIRECTIONAL 6h max: TP episodes end at the max IN the position's favor (a long that ran to +1.0% ends there); SL episodes end at the max adverse point.
